description: This file contains a class implementing hook functions for Drupal views, specifically for token information and token replacement logic related to views.

classes.name: ViewsTokensHooks
classes.description: A class implementing hook functions for Drupal views token handling.

methods.name: tokenInfo
methods.description: Provides token information related to views, such as label, description, ID, title, URL, base table, base field, total rows, items per page, current page, and page count.

methods.name: tokens
methods.description: Replaces tokens with actual view data, handling various token types like label, description, ID, title, URL, base table, base field, total rows, items per page, current page, and page count.
